The candidate will be responsible for developing and expanding our B2B client base for AML and compliance services. The key responsibilities will include:
li
Identifying and generating new B2B business opportunities for AML and compliance services.
li
Building and maintaining a strong pipeline of prospective corporate clients.
li
Conducting outreach through calls, emails, networking, meetings, and other business development channels.
li
Developing relationships with companies, business owners, senior management, and relevant decision-makers.
li
Understanding client requirements and presenting suitable AML/compliance service solutions.
li
Preparing and following up on quotations and proposals.
li
Managing the sales process from initial contact through to client onboarding and closing.
li
Maintaining accurate records of leads, opportunities, meetings, and sales activities.
li
Achieving agreed monthly and quarterly business development targets.
li
Monitoring market opportunities and identifying potential sectors and companies that may require AML services.
q: Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills.
Proven ability to generate leads and convert prospects into clients.
Good understanding of the UAE business environment.
Experience dealing with corporate clients and decision-makers is preferred.
Knowledge of AML/compliance services would be an advantage but is not mandatory .
x: Medical insurance, employment visa, and flight allowance.
Career progression within a rapidly growing business.

Access to industry-leading technology and systems.

If you're passionate about creating exceptional customer experiences and leading high-performing teams, we'd love to hear from you.

q: 6 to 10 years in logistics or supply chain, with at least 3 years managing a team.
Hands-on knowledge of GCC customs and regulatory frameworks.
Track record with freight forwarders, express carriers and customs brokers: contracts, SLAs, disputes.
Luxury, fashion or high-value goods logistics is a strong plus; events logistics an advantage.
SAP, Excel at advanced level, Power BI for reporting.
Cost control: rate cards, invoice reconciliation, budget follow-up.
Contract & Tender Management in Transportation & Customs Brokerage services
Structured writing and presenting, in English, for retail and executive audiences.
Calm under peak pressure and able to decide fast with partial information.
Develops people: gives ownership, coaches, holds the line on standards.
Rigorous on compliance; comfortable saying no to a store or a supplier when the rule requires it.
English fluent. French and/or Arabic an asset.
r: The Logistics Manager runs the flow of goods between Origins, the Dubai distribution Centre and 24 stores in six countries, from inbound to store delivery, through customs and regulatory compliance. This role manages four Logistics Executives, owns the carrier and broker relationships, and is accountable for service, cost and compliance on every lane.
The role turns a team of strong individual owners into one operation: shared priorities, one escalation path, one set of KPIs read by supply chain, retail, merchandising and finance.
Lead, develop and evaluate the four Logistics Executives; set objectives, run the weekly logistics review, hold the mid-year and annual reviews.
Keep ownership clear: one owner and one backup per task, cover during leave and peaks.
Be the single escalation point for stores, merchandising and retail on any logistics topic.
Own end-to-end visibility from departure in Europe to store receipt: in-transit tracking, lead times, claims.
Steer the inbound forwarder: capacity planning, service levels, rate card application, invoice reconciliation.
Plan and secure the inbound for events, window installations and store openings.
Guarantee customs compliance in six countries: declarations, duty optimization, audits, archives.
Own product regulatory affairs with the local authorities and inspection bodies: registrations, licenses, CITES.
Keep business continuity plans current for regulated categories.
Manage the carrier and broker portfolio: contracts, SLAs, performance reviews, claims and insurance.
Lead tenders and renewals with Legal and the central transport team.
Drive carrier integrations with the delivery management platform so every shipment is tracked end to end.
Own the logistics budget lines: transport, customs, brokerage and packaging.
Validate the full cost monthly; challenge every deviation from the agreed rate cards.
Publish the logistics KPIs to retail, merchandising and finance: lead time, on-time delivery, cost per unit, claims, compliance.
Prepare network changes with the distribution center.
